normalization.path: replace backslash with slash, remove leading ./, preserve case for exact identity, casefold only for collision diagnostics

identity_rules.governed_source_inventory: normalized governed-relative path plus content hash when available; preserve raw path.
identity_rules.workspace_artifact_catalog: normalized workspace-relative path plus artifact type; retain raw path and file/directory kind.
identity_rules.generated_artifact_catalog: generator or build class plus normalized output path; add content hash and generation record when available.
identity_rules.runtime_transient_catalog: normalized path plus transient/database class; sidecars retain parent database linkage when discoverable.
identity_rules.historical_artifact_register: legacy row id plus raw path and provenance snapshot; normalized path is secondary.

symlink_policy: Do not follow symlinks during inventory; record symlink as observed path if encountered.
hard_link_policy: Do not deduplicate solely by inode; retain path identities and optionally record shared content hash/inode diagnostics.
alias_policy: Aliases remain separate rows unless a governed alias relation exists.
duplicate_resolution: Within a subprojection, exact class-aware identity collision is resolved by deterministic source precedence; conflicting payloads produce a conflict record and block promotion.
transient_policy: Transient/database records are not deleted; they are isolated in runtime_transient_catalog.
